charts.title: TOI-5716 b: orbits around TOI-5716
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5716's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5716 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Gomez Barrientos et al. 2026 (2026AJ....171...99G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GOMEZ_BARRIENTOS_ET_AL_2026): P 6.7663 d
